Hi, this paper has only expression evidence. No evidence for catabolism; this is only an author speculation the discussion. This one is probably maturation. I haven't found strong evidence for catabolism yet. The description says this gene encodes a mammalian peptidase that, at neutral pH, removes tripeptides from the N-terminus of longer peptides. The protein has a specialized function that is essential for some MHC class I antigen presentation.
title: Annotation Dispute: Q64560 GO:0030163
